_about: Research (/research, Automated Analysis): every assumption the page's figures rest on, its default, its unit, its source and how to change it. The cards' inputs are the defaults of site/data/findings/catalogue.json (the request flow on /research offers the other choices); the rule's constants are warehouse/analysis/run.py's; the regressions' rules are the cards' own (warehouse/analysis/findings/<card>.py). replicate.py and replicate.do read the values below and nothing else of the page; assumptions.csv holds the numeric ones for Stata. A change here changes the replication, not the page: the page's figures are at these values, so a changed value gives a figure the page does not show.

batteries_lunch_grids_first_year.change: a person picks another choice in /research's request flow ("Or choose a finding and its inputs"); the data machine runs the card again (the only choice offered is 2019)

batteries_curtailment_curtailed.source: site/data/findings/catalogue.json, the card's default input (curtailed_mwh is solar and wind)
batteries_curtailment_curtailed.change: a person picks another choice in /research's request flow ("Or choose a finding and its inputs"); the data machine runs the card again (solar_only)

batteries_curtailment_first_month.change: a person picks another choice in /research's request flow ("Or choose a finding and its inputs"); the data machine runs the card again (2026-01)
